Please help us improve our site! × No thank you conveyanceA conveyance is the transfer and assignment of any property right or interest from one individual or entity (the conveyor) to another (the conveyee). This is usually accomplished through a written instrument - most often a deed - that transfers title to, or creates a lien on property.Some sources of authority consider the written instrument itself a “conveyance.”[Last reviewed in June of 2021 by the Wex Definitions Team]WexLIFE EVENTS family & personal matters financial events wills PROPERTY property & real estate law trusts inheritances & estates wex definitions Wex Toolbox Sponsored ListingsPaul Danziger PREMIUM(800) 864-4000Houston, TX Asbestos & MesotheliomaWebsiteEmailCallEmailProfileTor Hoerman PREMIUM(888) 508-6752St. Louis, MO Personal Injury, Medical Malpractice, Asbestos & Mesothelioma, Workers' Compensation, Elder Law, Environmental Law, Domestic Violence, Animal & Dog Law, Consumer Law, Military Law, Nursing Home Abuse, Products Liability, Social Security DisabilityWebsiteEmailCallEmailProfileDavid Gunn PREMIUM(314) 932-1067Brentwood, MO Bankruptcy, Criminal Law, Foreclosure Defense, Traffic TicketsWebsiteEmailCallEmailProfileAllison F.
